text.description_html:
Acorn BH1BI, 6' Barn Door Kit with Smooth Steel Squared Door Mounts

Barn doors are hot right now and for good reason. Not only are they super stylish, they can totally transform a room and inject big personality into any space. Perfect for areas where traditional swinging or pocket doors are impractical, barn doors allow you to break up rooms in a beautiful way. With the Square Mount Sliding Barn Door Kit with 6 Foot Track, this sometimes confusing home improvement project becomes simple. This Barn Door Hardware Kit comes with everything you need to install a 3 foot door. This sliding door kit is available in the customary black and bronze, but it is also available in bolder finish options too like yellow, red, and white! It is made out of smooth steel, so you know that it will stand the test of time. The anti-jump feature ensures that the barn door will stay on the track.

Features of the Acorn BH1BI, 6 Foot Flat Track Rolling Barn Door Kit:

  • Kit package includes everything you need to install a barn door.
  • Made from steel for durability and strength.
  • Anti-jump track blocks.
  • Available in 9 brilliant colors.

Specifications of the Barn Door Hardware Kit:

  • Track: 6 feet (72 inches)
  • For doors up to 3 feet (36 inches)
  • For wood doors up to 300 lbs.
  • Package Includes: 6' track, wheel Carriers, standoffs, end stops, anti jump blocks, and door bottom stabilizers.
  • Acorn Sliding Barn Door Kit Installation Instructions (PDF)

In case of a doorway larger than 3 feet, custom length tracks are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Finish option Flat Black is in stock for immediate shipment. Please Contact Us for current estimated delivery times on all other finishes. All other finishes are special order and NOT RETURNABLE.
